title: The Omnipresence of God
definition: The omnipresence of God means that God is present everywhere and not limited by space.
summary: No place is hidden from God. His presence brings comfort to His people and accountability to all creation.
christFocus: Through Christ, believers are brought near to God and receive the presence of the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: No place is hidden from God. His presence brings comfort to His people and accountability to all creation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
